status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Confirm and correct A4 page height behavior, then add direct page-number input navigation.
assumptions: A4 page chrome should stay exactly 210mm by 297mm at 100% zoom.
Overflowing section content can remain a follow-up pagination issue, but the page container itself should not grow taller.
Direct page input should accept 1-based page numbers and clamp invalid ranges.

tasks.title: Fix A4 visual height
tasks.summary: Use fixed height instead of min-height so the displayed page does not grow beyond A4.
verify: .exam-page-frame has height based on 297mm and zoom.

tasks.title: Add direct page number input
tasks.targets: section-viewer.html toolbar render and page navigation JS
tasks.summary: Replace passive page text with a numeric input that jumps to the requested page.
verify: Toolbar contains a numeric page input.
Enter/change clamps to 1 through total page count.
The total page count remains visible.

tasks.title: Validate and archive checklist
tasks.summary: Run syntax and string checks, then archive this checklist.
verify: Relevant CSS and input strings are present.
Checklist parses and filename count matches.
